name: Log source health — Splunk and Microsoft Sentinel
description: Generic operational queries for reviewing log volume and the most recent event seen from indexes, hosts, sources and common Microsoft Sentinel log sources. No fixed silence threshold is applied.
author: SOCx Community

variables.label: Lookback window
variables.description: Search far enough back to include sources that may have stopped reporting.

variables.label: Chart bucket
variables.description: Time bucket used by volume charts.

variables.label: Splunk index pattern
variables.description: Index name or wildcard, for example main, security_* or *.

variables.label: Sentinel computer regex
variables.description: Regular expression applied to the Computer field, for example ^srv- or .*.

variables.label: Sentinel CEF device regex
variables.description: Regular expression applied to CommonSecurityLog DeviceName.

templates.name: Splunk — event volume over time by index
templates.description: Charts event counts per index using indexed metadata. Useful for spotting ingestion drops without imposing a fixed threshold.
templates.body:
| tstats count AS events WHERE index={{var:index}} earliest=-{{var:range}} BY _time span={{var:span}} index
| timechart span={{var:span}} sum(events) AS events BY index limit=0 useother=f

templates.name: Splunk — last event received by index
templates.description: Shows the newest indexed event for every matching index, plus the event count in the selected lookback window.
templates.body:
| tstats count AS events max(_time) AS last_event WHERE index={{var:index}} earliest=-{{var:range}} BY index
| eval hours_since_last=round((now()-last_event)/3600,2)
| eval last_event=strftime(last_event,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z")
| table index, last_event, hours_since_last, events
| sort 0 - hours_since_last

templates.name: Splunk — event volume over time by host
templates.description: Charts event counts for matching hosts inside the selected index pattern.
templates.body:
| tstats count AS events WHERE index={{var:index}} host="{{var:host}}" earliest=-{{var:range}} BY _time span={{var:span}} host
| timechart span={{var:span}} sum(events) AS events BY host limit=0 useother=f

templates.name: Splunk — last event received by host
templates.description: Lists matching hosts and the timestamp of their newest event in the selected lookback window.
templates.body:
| tstats count AS events max(_time) AS last_event WHERE index={{var:index}} host="{{var:host}}" earliest=-{{var:range}} BY index host
| eval hours_since_last=round((now()-last_event)/3600,2)
| eval last_event=strftime(last_event,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z")
| table index, host, last_event, hours_since_last, events
| sort 0 - hours_since_last

templates.name: Splunk — last event by host, source and sourcetype
templates.description: Breaks log freshness down to indexed source metadata so a stale input can be isolated beneath a healthy index or host.
templates.body:
| tstats count AS events max(_time) AS last_event WHERE index={{var:index}} host="{{var:host}}" source="{{var:source}}" sourcetype="{{var:sourcetype}}" earliest=-{{var:range}} BY index host sourcetype source
| eval hours_since_last=round((now()-last_event)/3600,2)
| eval last_event=strftime(last_event,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z")
| table index, host, sourcetype, source, last_event, hours_since_last, events
| sort 0 - hours_since_last

templates.name: Sentinel — ingestion volume over time by table
templates.description: Charts ingested megabytes per table from the Usage table. This is efficient and avoids scanning every event table.
templates.body:
Usage
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| summarize IngestedMB = sum(Quantity) by bin(TimeGenerated, {{var:span}}), Type
| extend IngestedMB = round(IngestedMB, 2)
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
| render timechart

templates.name: Sentinel — last heartbeat received by computer
templates.description: Shows the latest Heartbeat record for each matching computer. Useful for agent-backed Windows and Linux systems.
templates.body:
Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where Computer matches regex "{{var:computer-regex}}"
| summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated), Heartbeats = count(), ComputerIP = take_any(ComputerIP), OSType = take_any(OSType), Version = take_any(Version) by Computer
| extend HoursSinceLast = round(datetime_diff("minute", now(), LastHeartbeat) / 60.0, 2)
| project Computer, OSType, Version, ComputerIP, LastHeartbeat, HoursSinceLast, Heartbeats
| sort by HoursSinceLast desc

templates.name: Sentinel — heartbeat volume over time by computer
templates.description: Charts Heartbeat counts by computer to make collection interruptions visually obvious.
templates.body:
Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where Computer matches regex "{{var:computer-regex}}"
| summarize Heartbeats = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {{var:span}}), Computer
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
| render timechart

templates.name: Sentinel — last Syslog event by computer
templates.description: Shows the newest Syslog record for each matching computer and host identity.
templates.body:
Syslog
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where Computer matches regex "{{var:computer-regex}}"
| summarize LastEvent = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count(), Facilities = make_set(Facility, 10), Severities = make_set(SeverityLevel, 10) by Computer, HostName, HostIP
| extend HoursSinceLast = round(datetime_diff("minute", now(), LastEvent) / 60.0, 2)
| project Computer, HostName, HostIP, LastEvent, HoursSinceLast, Events, Facilities, Severities
| sort by HoursSinceLast desc

templates.name: Sentinel — last CEF event by device
templates.description: Shows the newest CommonSecurityLog event per CEF device, vendor and product.
templates.body:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago({{var:range}})
| where DeviceName matches regex "{{var:device-regex}}"
| summarize LastEvent = max(TimeGenerated), Events = count(), Collectors = make_set(Computer, 10) by DeviceVendor, DeviceProduct, DeviceName
| extend HoursSinceLast = round(datetime_diff("minute", now(), LastEvent) / 60.0, 2)
| project DeviceVendor, DeviceProduct, DeviceName, LastEvent, HoursSinceLast, Events, Collectors
| sort by HoursSinceLast desc
